verdict.rationale: Insomnia (part of Kong's ecosystem) supports environments with global/collection/folder-level variable sets that can be applied across requests, which supports switching contexts like dev/staging/prod for API calls. However, this is Insomnia's client-side testing feature, not Kong Gateway itself, and there's no explicit documentation showing a named dev/staging/prod workflow or Gateway-level environment variable switching for routing traffic between environments. missing for 10: explicit dev/staging/prod workflow documentation, Kong Gateway-level (not just Insomnia client) environment switching, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this exact use case.
